name: nuclear receptor binding SET domain protein 3

function.text: NSD3 encodes histone-lysine N-methyltransferase NSD3. Annotated molecular activities include histone H3 methyltransferase activity and histone H3K27 dimethyltransferase activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include NUT carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
